intent: What a list, card, chart or page shows when its data failed to load: an icon, what failed, a reference and Try again.
useWhen: A request for a region's data failed
A Skeleton is replaced by the failure in the same space
A support reference should be copyable
doNotUseWhen: Nothing to show but nothing failed — use Empty
A page-level notice or a failed save — use Alert or Toast
A form field is invalid — use Field error

message.note: What failed, named, like "Couldn't load invoices." Not "Something went wrong".

reference.note: Text people can copy for support, rendered as given in mono under the message, like "Ref 7F3A-91C2".

onRetry.note: Shows a neutral sm "Try again" Button (KitLabels tryAgain). If a retry fails again and focus was lost with the old button, the new LoadError focuses Try again; otherwise focus stays put.

size.note: Same scale as Empty. sm: in a chart, list or table cell, bare 16px icon. md: a card body, 32px danger tile. lg: a page, 40px tile and a larger message.

requirements: role=alert, so the failure is read when it appears
The CircleX icon is aria-hidden; the message says what failed, so colour is never the only signal
Focus stays put when the error replaces a Skeleton; it returns to Try again only after the person pressed it
Try again is a kit Button with one verb

doNot: Do not build a local error row or banner for failed data — use LoadError
Do not label the button Retry or Reload — the label is Try again (KitLabels tryAgain)
Do not show the failure with colour alone
Do not leave the Skeleton on screen after a failure
Do not use raw hex or primitive --color-* ramps
